text:
Mara: quick sync  benchmark visuals + webinar hook. want to reframe from mean-latency charts to SLA-first storytelling: show how configs meet 99th pct tail at different unit costs.

Devin: yes. mean hides tail. product teams ask if chat stays snappy at peak, not average token time.

Sam: design brief 
 three panels:
- Panel 1: SLA compliance curve 
 probability(99th <= X ms) vs $/1M tokens, separate lines per config
- Panel 2: cost waterfall for 100k requests (batching / cache / model compute)
- Panel 3: persona tradeoff (chat vs search vs embeddings) with recommended configs

Leah: can someone drop a tiny CSV and cost ticks so design can mock with real numbers?

Mara: dropping quick CSV:
latency_ms,small_batch,medium_batch,prefix_cache
150,0.62,0.75,0.93
200,0.78,0.89,0.98
250,0.90,0.95,0.995
300,0.95,0.985,0.999
costs per 1M tokens: small_batch=1200, medium_batch=850, prefix_cache=420

Tom: perfect. design can plot probability curves and add vertical cost ticks. label axes: "P(99th <= X ms)" and "$ per 1M tokens".

Mara: hero copy options, pick one:
A) "Keep apps snappy: 99th percentile under 250ms at predictable unit cost"
B) "Cut per-query spend 2x-3x without sacrificing tail latency"
C) "SLA-ready inference for chat, search, and embeddings"

Sam: B resonates for acquisition; A good for enterprise docs.

Leah: webinar plan 
 30 min total: 20 demo + 10 Q&A. demo flow: run app under load -> flip routing to cheaper variant + enable prefix cache -> show 99th stays within SLA and cost drops. record a 5-min clip for LP.

Devin: eng will provide a traffic script and a small dashboard that reports 99th over a 1M token run. will add a trace span to mark the flip. ETA 3 days for clean recording.

Tom: inbound tagging for demand gen: add tags ["lead:tail-sla","lead:unit-econ","lead:embeddings-efficiency"] to anyone who downloads the benchmark whitepaper or watches the demo. nurture path: whitepaper -> 5-min clip -> sales config templates.

Mara: action items:
- Design: mock the 3 panels from the CSV by EOD Thu
- Content: one-pager (hero + 3 bullets + CTA) + webinar script draft
- Growth: wire tags + basic funnel in HubSpot/GA

Sam: I'll write the one-pager. rough CTA: "See how we keep your SLA — and cut spend — in one click."

Leah: i'll spin up the signup page and slide template. target date two weeks out.

Mara: please drop early PNGs and the trace logs here; i'll lock the hero claim by Friday.

marketing-bot: sprint created: "benchmark-sla-visuals" due in 10 days. :rocket:
